faq_make_booking_q: How do I make a booking?
faq_make_booking_a:
Booking a service in UstaHub is simple:

1. Open the Home tab from the bottom menu.
2. Browse service categories or use the search bar to find what you need.
3. Tap on the service that matches your needs.
4. Review the master's profile, reviews, and pricing.
5. Tap the 'Book Now' button.
6. Select your preferred date and time.
7. Enter the service address.
8. Add any extra notes for the master.
9. Choose your payment method (**Cash** or **Card**).
10. Confirm your booking by tapping 'Confirm Booking'.

You will receive a notification once the master accepts your request.
faq_view_bookings_q: How can I view my bookings?
faq_view_bookings_a:
You can view all your bookings easily:

1. Open the app and look at the bottom navigation bar.
2. Tap the **Bookings** tab.
3. Here you will see all your active, completed, and cancelled bookings.
4. Use the filter tabs to switch between Active, Completed, and Cancelled.
5. Tap any booking to see full details including master info, service time, and status.
faq_cancel_booking_q: How do I cancel a booking?
faq_cancel_booking_a:
To cancel a booking:

1. Go to the **Bookings** tab from the bottom menu.
2. Find the booking you want to cancel.
3. Tap on it to open the booking details.
4. Scroll down and tap 'Cancel Booking'.
5. Provide a reason for cancellation (at least 6 characters).
6. Confirm by tapping 'Confirm Cancellation'.

Note: If less than 2 hours remain before the service starts, you must contact support to cancel.
faq_reschedule_a:
Currently, to reschedule a booking you need to:

1. Cancel the existing booking from the Bookings tab.
2. Make a new booking with the desired date and time.

If the service is less than 2 hours away, please contact our support team for assistance.
faq_booking_status_q: How do I check my booking status?
faq_booking_status_a:
To check your booking status:

1. Open the **Bookings** tab.
2. Each booking shows its current status: Active, Confirmed, In Progress, Completed, or Cancelled.
3. Tap the booking for detailed status updates and master information.
4. You will also receive push notifications whenever the status changes.
faq_edit_profile_q: How do I edit my profile information?
faq_edit_profile_a:
Editing your profile is easy:

1. Go to the **Profile** tab from the bottom navigation.
2. Tap on 'Personal Information' under the Account section.
3. Update your first name, last name, or email address.
4. Tap the 'Save' button at the bottom.

Your changes will be applied immediately.
faq_change_phone_q: How do I change my phone number?
faq_change_phone_a:
Your phone number is your account identifier and cannot be changed directly within the app. To update your phone number:

1. Go to Profile > Information > Work with us / Contact email.
2. Reach out to our support team via email or call center.
3. Provide your current phone number and the new one.
4. Support will verify your identity and update it for you.
faq_change_language_q: How do I change the app language?
faq_change_language_a:
UstaHub supports three languages: **English**, **Russian**, and **Uzbek**.

1. Open the Profile tab.
2. Find the Settings section.
3. Tap on 'Language'.
4. Choose your preferred language from the dropdown.

The app will switch to your selected language immediately.
faq_delete_account_q: How can I delete my account?
faq_delete_account_a:
To delete your account permanently:

1. Open the Profile tab.
2. Scroll down to the bottom of the page.
3. Tap on 'Delete Account'.
4. Read all the warnings carefully — this action is permanent.
5. Tap the red 'Delete my account' button.
6. Confirm in the dialog by tapping 'Yes'.

Warning: Once deleted, your account, data, bookings, and history cannot be recovered.
faq_logout_a:
To log out of your account:

1. Open the Profile tab.
2. Scroll to the bottom of the page.
3. Tap the 'Logout' button.
4. Confirm by tapping 'Yes' in the dialog.

You can log back in anytime using your phone number.
faq_search_q: How do I search for a service?
faq_search_a:
Finding the right service is quick:

1. Open the Home tab.
2. Tap on the search bar at the top.
3. Type the service name or a keyword.
4. Browse the results that appear.
5. Tap any result to see service details.

You can also browse by category if you don't know exactly what to search for.
faq_categories_q: How do I browse service categories?
faq_categories_a:
To explore service categories:

1. Open the Home tab.
2. You will see category cards on the home screen.
3. Tap any category (e.g., Cleaning, Plumbing, Electrical).
4. Browse all services within that category.
5. Tap a service to view its details and providers.
faq_find_best_master_q: How do I find the best master?
faq_find_best_master_a:
Tips for finding the best master:

1. Check the master's **rating** (out of 5 stars).
2. Read recent reviews from other clients.
3. Look at the number of completed services.
4. Check the master's profile for experience and specialization.
5. Compare prices among similar masters.
6. Choose a master with high ratings and positive feedback.
faq_add_card_q: How do I add a payment card?
faq_add_card_a:
To add a payment card:

1. Open the Profile tab.
2. Under Account, tap 'My Card'.
3. Tap the '+' or 'Add New Card' button.
4. Enter your card number, expiration date, and CVV.
5. Confirm with the SMS code sent to your phone.
6. Your card will be saved securely for future payments.
faq_payment_history_q: Where can I see my payment history?
faq_payment_history_a:
To view your payment history:

1. Open the Profile tab.
2. Under the Account section, tap 'Payment History'.
3. You will see all your past transactions with date, amount, and status.
4. Tap any transaction to see full details.
faq_payment_methods_a:
UstaHub accepts two payment methods:

• **Cash** — Pay the master directly after the service is completed.
• **Card** — Pay securely through the app using your saved credit or debit card.

You can choose your preferred payment method when making a booking.
faq_leave_review_q: How do I leave a review?
faq_leave_review_a:
To leave a review for a master:

1. Wait until your booking is marked as **Completed**.
2. Go to the Bookings tab and open the completed booking.
3. Tap 'Leave a Review' or 'Rate Service'.
4. Rate the master from 1 to 5 stars.
5. Write your honest feedback (optional but recommended).
6. Tap 'Submit'.

Your review helps other users choose the right master.
faq_rate_service_q: How do I rate a service?
faq_rate_service_a:
Rating a service is part of the review process:

1. Open the completed booking from the Bookings tab.
2. Select the number of stars (**1 = poor**, **5 = excellent**).
3. Optionally add comments about what went well or poorly.
4. Submit your rating.

Honest ratings help maintain service quality on the platform.
faq_contact_support_a:
You can contact our support team in several ways:

• **Telegram (fastest)**: Open **Profile > Contact Support**. This opens our official support chat with Admin. You can also write directly to Admin on Telegram.
• **Email**: Write to company@ustahub.net.
• **In-app**: Go to the Profile tab and tap 'Contact Support' under the Information section.

Our team responds within 24 hours, usually much sooner. For urgent issues, Telegram is the quickest way to reach us.
faq_master_no_show_q: What should I do if the master doesn't show up?
faq_master_no_show_a:
If the master fails to arrive at the scheduled time:

1. Wait at least 15 minutes past the scheduled time.
2. Try calling the master using the contact info in the booking details.
3. If unreachable, open **Profile > Contact Support** to start a Telegram chat with our support team (Admin).
4. Send the booking number and explain that the master didn't arrive.
5. Support will help you reschedule, find another master, or get a refund.

We take master no-shows seriously and will take action against unreliable providers.
faq_complain_master_q: How do I file a complaint about a master?
faq_complain_master_a:
If a master behaved unprofessionally or provided poor service:

1. Open **Profile > Contact Support** — this opens a Telegram chat with our support team (Admin).
2. Send the booking number and the master's name.
3. Describe the issue in detail — be specific about what happened.
4. Attach photos if possible as evidence.
5. Submit your complaint, and we will investigate and take action.

You can also leave a low-star review with detailed feedback to warn other users. Our team investigates every complaint and may suspend masters who repeatedly receive complaints.
faq_bad_review_q: How do I report bad behavior?
faq_bad_review_a:
If a master behaved inappropriately:

1. Document the incident with photos, screenshots, or notes.
2. Open **Profile > Contact Support** to message our support team on Telegram (Admin).
3. Provide the booking number and the master's name.
4. Describe the incident in detail and attach any evidence you have.
5. Leave an honest review on the master's profile.

For urgent safety concerns, contact local authorities first, then notify UstaHub support via Telegram (Admin) so we can ban the master from our platform.
faq_what_is_ustahub_a:
UstaHub is your trusted platform for finding skilled local masters for any home or personal service.

With UstaHub you can:

• Find verified masters in your area
• Book services like cleaning, plumbing, electrical work, and more
• Read reviews and ratings from real clients
• Pay securely through the app
• Track service status in real-time
• Manage all your bookings in one place

Our mission is to make professional services accessible, reliable, and convenient for everyone.
faq_how_it_works_a:
UstaHub connects clients with professional masters in 4 simple steps:

1. **Find** — Browse categories or search for the service you need.
2. **Book** — Choose a master, pick a date and time, and confirm your booking.
3. **Receive** — The master arrives at your location and completes the service.
4. **Pay & Review** — Pay through the app or in cash, then leave a review to help others.

All masters on UstaHub are verified and rated by real clients.
faq_data_safety_a:
Yes, your data is protected:

• We use industry-standard encryption to protect your information.
• Payment details are processed through secure payment gateways and never stored in plain text.
• Your personal information is never shared with third parties without your consent.
• You can delete your account and data at any time from the Profile page.
• You can read our full Privacy Policy in Profile > Information > Privacy Policy.

For any privacy concerns, contact our support team.
faq_notifications_a:
To manage your notification preferences:

1. Open the **Profile** tab.
2. Scroll to the Settings section.
3. Find the 'Notifications' option.
4. Toggle the switch on or off.

When enabled, you'll receive updates about booking status, master arrival, special offers, and important account information.
